LOOK: Health workers, doctors, nurses, health professionals, and health advocates held a Black Friday protest in front of the Department of Health (DOH) gate in Manila on Friday, Nov. 21, as part of the Health Sector Day of Action Against Corruption. 

Carrying placards and lying on the ground to express their outrage, they also threw paint at photos of government officials allegedly involved in corruption. 

📸: Mark Balmores/MB
